7461.title: Checkpoint contention invalidates a pinned-WAL test observation
7461.rootCauseOneLine: The test reads PASSIVE checkpoint frame counts without handling the busy sentinel while a competing checkpoint lock can be held.

prReviews.verdict: Static diff aligned with the cause; no linked PR code executed.

7461.proposedFix: Retry busy checkpoint observations asynchronously with a deadline while retaining the pinned-WAL assertions.
7461.caveats: Two clean Linux runs with real checkpoint-lock contention; Windows CI frequency unverified. Open linked PR #7462 prevents a duplicate fix.
